Sir, mera top-down analysis 1D → 4H → 1H → 15M → 5M hota hai. 1D par main daily bias determine karta hoon, 4H par structure, 1H par trend/context, 15M par zones/levels mark karta hoon aur 5M par entry leta hoon.
Mera main problem ye hai ki main 1D ke bias ko hi trade lene ka reason bana deta hoon. Jaise agar daily bullish bias hai, to 5M par koi bhi bullish setup milne par main trade le leta hoon—breakout, reversal, trap, support/resistance liquidity sweep, trap trading etc. Is wajah se main ek fixed setup ko wait karne ke bajay multiple setups trade karta hoon aur losses ho rahi hai.

1. Mera question hai: kya mujhe 1D bias ko sirf directional filter ki tarah use karna chahiye aur uske baad ek specific setup ko hi trade karna chahiye? Ya daily bias ke according multiple setups trade karna sahi approach hai?.

2. Agar mujhe ek specific setup select karna chahiye, to 1D → 4H → 1H → 15M → 5M ke beech exact filtering process kya hona chahiye, taaki mujhe clear ho ki kaunsa setup trade karna hai aur kaunsa setup ignore karna hai?.

3. Main apni trading ko “bias → location → setup → confirmation → entry” ke rule-based system mein convert karna chahta hoon. Aapke experience ke according mujhe is process ko kaise define karna chahiye?.

Mera main problem ye hai ki main 1D ke bias ko hi trade lene ka reason bana deta hoon. Jaise agar daily bullish bias hai, to 5M par koi bhi bullish setup milne par main trade le leta hoon—breakout, reversal, trap, support/resistance liquidity sweep, trap trading etc. Is wajah se main ek fixed setup ko wait karne ke bajay multiple setups trade karta hoon aur losses ho rahi hai.
